transcript: The other night, my boyfriend Paul and I went to the Sweeney Todd revival, currently on Broadway, starring Josh Groban and Annalee Ashford. Sweeney is a song time classic, but this was actually the first time I'd seen a production of it. Sweeney Todd is about a barber who murders his clients and his partner in crime who bakes them into pies. This revival is not quite as big as I was expecting in terms of production elements and staging, but the emphasis on the performances certainly leaves nothing to be desired, as everyone is great. Annalee Ashford is such a scene stealer in this show, and I thought she and Josh Groban had great chemistry together. Also, the music really shines through in this production, especially with a full orchestra. Considering we were sitting pretty far back, we were really impressed with the sound design and how well we could still hear and understand the actors. If you're looking for a spooky classic, especially now that Phantom is closed, definitely check this one out. With that, another playbill for my collection.
